warning: Core envelope follows the period map's named jurisdiction, inside its coarse boundary. It is not the entire historical duchy or an exact cadastre. Every untraced fringe remains unresolved rather than certified Prussian.
Soest and its Borde belonged to Cleves/Prussia by 1776 and are excluded; Westphalian ducal title does not confer sovereignty over the whole geographic Westphalia or the Paderborn bishopric.

Only three retained PRU parent masks are reviewed. Existing WPD, WPM, KPF territories and all preceding twenty new RGB and 1081 restored cells remain intact. The old unresolved PRU remainder of x4101A0 may be split; this is explicitly a later correction, not replacement of its Paderborn child.

The western Vest core is a separate Cologne jurisdiction, not an extension of the Westphalian ducal title. Its eastern and northern fringes are not traced here. The unresolved native Dortmund city anchor and Essen wood anchor are left unchanged and outside the transferred core.

The older Schenk circle map omits Cologne's electoral-Rhenish-circle duchy from the coloured member estates. White areas alone are not ownership evidence; Vaugondy's political outline and LWL's specific territorial history establish the attribution.

Cross-map discrepancies and native locator bias prevent exact physical positions from being claimed. No 7.20-pixel translation, source-city circular province assignment, hub move or Erfurt optimization.
No new countries, governments, titles or military units. Cologne's existing capital remains unchanged; added land joins its existing country, not a sovereign duchy.

Erfurt-Eichsfeld, Hanover/Minden, Belgium, Franconia, all earlier MAP sectors and Swabia unchanged except exact compiled registry dependencies. Population profiles, building holders, PMs and units must remain conserved.
